name: Figranium
description: Figranium is a self-hosted browser automation platform. You build workflows from blocks such as navigate, click, type and extract in a visual editor, run them in headless Chromium, and trigger them from the UI, on a schedule or through the REST API.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first visitor becomes the administrator. Create the account right after the install.
Workflows cannot open LAN addresses by default. To automate local services, set ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORKS=true in /opt/figranium_data/.env and run systemctl restart figranium.
To run tasks over the REST API, generate a key under Settings > API Keys and send it in the x-api-key header.
